# Oregon Audits — Secretary of State Audits Division

> Non-authoritative, AI-friendly reference for Performance, financial, IT and hotline audits published by the Oregon Secretary of State Audits Division — the constitutional auditor of Oregon state government — together with their findings, recommendations, and the audited agency's response..
> Full verbatim text of jurisdiction-authored documents is included in-repo;
> third-party materials are summarized with links to official sources.
> Always verify against the authoritative source linked in each document.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents working in this corpus
- [STATUS.md](STATUS.md): freshness, coverage, and drift at a glance
